objective: Preallocate collecting bare aggregate accumulators from the bounded input row count.

tasks.title: Preallocate bare aggregate collectors
tasks.result: Bare aggregate execution now initializes collecting accumulators with a bounded input-row capacity hint.

notes: Cargo/linker verification used an E: workspace temp directory because the default C:/TEMP drive was previously full.
The input capacity hint is bounded by AGGREGATE_PREALLOC_LIMIT to avoid large eager allocations.
Group-by accumulator initialization remains unchanged to avoid overallocating per group.
